text: Global Risk Analyst | Assesses the dashboard's global risk level, risk score and main contributing events. | Use this skill for questions about the overall global situation, current risk level, top threat, severity, prioritisation and factors affecting the risk score.

Cyber Threat Analyst | Finds and prioritises critical CVEs, software vulnerabilities and cyber incidents. | Always select this skill when a request mentions CVE, CVSS, critical vulnerability, urgent vulnerability investigation, CISA KEV, ransomware, exploitation, data breach, threat intelligence or cybersecurity.

Disaster Analyst | Analyses natural disasters and severe environmental events. | Use this skill for questions about earthquakes, volcanoes, severe weather, disaster alerts, event locations, magnitude, depth and emergency awareness.

Aviation Analyst | Analyses aircraft activity shown on the dashboard. | Use this skill for questions about aircraft counts, locations, callsigns, countries, altitude, speed and unusual aviation activity.
Maritime Analyst | Analyses maritime activity and vessel movements. | Use this skill for questions about cargo vessels, tankers, ports, shipping traffic, vessel locations and maritime risks.

Space Operations Analyst | Analyses space activity and orbital conditions. | Use this skill for questions about the International Space Station, crew, satellites, orbital positions, altitude, velocity and space weather.

Network Intelligence Analyst | Analyses internet infrastructure and connectivity threats. | Use this skill for questions about internet outages, BGP anomalies, route hijacking, regional connectivity and network disruptions.

Threat Correlation Analyst | Identifies possible relationships between dashboard events. | Use this skill for questions about correlated threats, confidence scores, related cyber events, cascading risks and connections between intelligence domains.

Feed Health Analyst | Checks whether dashboard data sources are operating correctly. | Use this skill for questions about feed availability, update status, failed feeds, stale information and data-source reliability.
